title: Campus Bus Sync

examples.explanation: Buses every 4, 6 and 10 minutes all leave together again at minute 60, the least common multiple. Two buses every 7 minutes meet every 7 minutes.

hints: All buses leave together at minute t exactly when every period divides t. The smallest such t > 0 is the least common multiple of the periods.
lcm(a, b) = a / gcd(a, b) · b. Fold it over the list: lcm(a, b, c) = lcm(lcm(a, b), c).
Divide before you multiply. a · b can overflow even when the lcm itself fits.
